name: cbio-mel-iatlas-riaz-nivolumab-2017
description: Whole-exome sequencing and neoantigen landscape analysis of tumors from 64 advanced melanoma patients, profiled before and after nivolumab treatment. The reprocessing of raw sequencing data is coordinated by CRI iAtlas.
